name: 問いと三つの感謝の記録
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset: LH13-0010「問いと三つの感謝の記録」, ONE Japanese gratitude journal card.
REFERENCE HIERARCHY: Image1 ORIGINAL Calm screenshot controls first journal card's alignment, proportions, typography hierarchy, spacing, fine detail and actual source content. Use only its 7:14AM entry, not week strip or second card. Image2 FigCraft mock is SECONDARY Japanese wording/layout; its list substitutions Family/Friends/Neighbors do not preserve the original My dog/My sisters/My friends. Restore the original list meaning in Japanese as below and restore the source Friday marker. Image3 approved Lighthouse bus is STYLE ONLY for white surfaces, subtle neutral borders and restrained downward shadow.
Render one compact rounded WHITE card on pure WHITE canvas. Left-aligned metadata date at top, a bold two-line reflection question, then a three-line numbered list. No icon, checkbox, tag, button, green marker, title outside card, extra entry or decorative illustration.
Exact text:
metadata「2025年12月19日（金）午前7:14」
question line1「今日は誰との関わりに」
question line2「感謝していますか？」
list lines「1. 飼い犬」「2. 姉妹」「3. 友だち」.
Preserve all text, numbers and punctuation and these line breaks. These list values are faithful Japanese translations of the ORIGINAL source rather than the mock's content substitutions.
Typography locked: Meiryo Regular12px/16px metadata, Meiryo Bold14px/24px question, Meiryo Regular14px/24px numbered list, tracking0. Do not enlarge into a20px heading or make the list bold. Main ink#1D1D1D, secondary metadata#6E6E6E. Align question and list along the same left baseline. Compact purposeful spacing, all3 list lines visible.
Accent decision: source's dark gradient card is presentation, with no selected state/data grouping or primary action requiring an accent. Omit accents. Pure white surface, fine neutral outline, soft downward shadow, quiet22–24px logical corners, no broad mint fill/gloss/glow or nested boxes. Logical390x197 proportion with modest white outer margin, full card no clipping. A static raster candidate only.
reviewNotes: 原画の7:14AMの第1記録とモックを実見。原画の三項目My dog/My sisters/My friendsを飼い犬/姉妹/友だちへ忠実に訳し、モックの別内容と欠落した金曜を補正。状態や操作に意味色がないためアクセントなし。結果実見:2025年12月19日金午前7:14・問い2行・番号付き3項目・白面・文字の階層・見切れなしを確認。厳密なMeiryo実体は未証明。reviewedは画像候補の視覚レビューで所有者承認/編集性/実装ではない。
